name: QCARD
description:
qcard.fun, made by thechaingamer is a project that rewards holders with Pokémon cards. It is a Quotrons (created by cruelhandeth) ecosystem community project!

We've migrated from RH to Ink and are launching on hookit as a 404 token. NFTs that are activated will have a higher weightage in terms of chances of winning Pokémon cards.
